tools.name: water_availability
tools.description: Replenishable-water availability at a point. Free = public groundwater trend; paid adds a derived (non-locating) atlas indication.

tools.name: seismic_hazard
tools.description: Seismic hazard via the public, outcome-excluded prediction ledger.

tools.name: ground_stability
tools.description: Subsidence / void / karst / fault risk from verified observations.

tools.name: resource_indication
tools.description: Geothermal / mineral / gas / water indication (gated, low-confidence).

tools.name: space_weather_grid_risk
tools.description: Live geomagnetic activity (Kp) as GIC / space-weather grid exposure.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify a claim hash / the ledger hash chain against the Bitcoin anchor.

tools.name: ground_truth
tools.description: The bundled five-question answer + one provenance record.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: What DeepMap can answer now + coverage counts (public aggregate).

tools.name: check_hypothesis
tools.description: Has this Earth-science hypothesis been tested? Query the Null Museum + the Bitcoin-anchored hypothesis registry. A direct match returns the verdict + the positive control that proves the test was sensitive + the honest bound + the anchor -- so an agent never re-runs a dead idea.

claim.description: the hypothesis in plain words, e.g. 'does dv/v predict earthquakes'

tools.name: list_nulls
tools.description: List DeepMap's documented nulls / bounds / retractions (the Null Museum), optionally by domain -- each with the positive control that makes it trustworthy. We carry our own retractions; that is the credibility.

tools.name: run_controlled_test
tools.description: The Lab-as-an-API: run a REAL, bounded controlled test at a location and get an honest verdict. DeepMap fetches real data, runs a lock-in detection with a local-background null AND a positive control (a known reference line must be recovered, else UNTESTABLE). Free tier runs a synthetic demo; the live lab is the authenticated tier.
